name: stele
description: Answer questions about code from deterministic facts, and check code and typed specifications.

interface.shortDescription: Check code and specifications from deterministic facts.
interface.longDescription: Use Stele to extract deterministic code facts, check code against shipped checkers, measure what a change made harder to maintain, and write typed specifications that are checked, mutation-tested and rendered.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Stele to answer this question about the code from its facts and check it.
